043package dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources;
044
045import java.sql.SQLException;
046
047import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.DbOpsChangeEvent;
048import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsAction;
049import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsAction.Navigation;
050import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsModel;
051
052/**
053 * Interface that provides a set of methods to perform custom operations
054 * before and/or after certain database related operations. SS requires
055 * that application changes to the database are reflected in the RowSet;
056 * thus the displayed information has the changes that are made.
057 * Typically the "Pre" operations operate on
058 * SsComponents associated with an app window; and the "Post" operations
059 * make sure the changes are visible in the RowSet (commonly by re-executing
060 * the query).
061 * There are also other methods to prevent/allow or assist
062 * certain actions, for example {@code allowDelete()} or {@code performCancelOps()}.
063 * <p>
064 * In this class' documentation there are references to {@link RowsAction}
065 * enum values which have associated actions. The actions
066 * are typically invoked by a <b>navigator button push</b> which invokes the
067 * associated action,
068 * for example see {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsDataNavigator}
069 * <p>
070 * This interface has only default methods, none of which do anything; it
071 * can be instantiated by doing {@code new DbOps() {}}.
072 * <p>
073 * Generally the user will want to <b>use/extend
074 * {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.products.DbOpsBase}</b>
075 * <ul>
076 * <li> it has an implementation of
077 * {@link DbOps#performPreInsertOps() performPreInsertOps()}
078 * that will clear/initialize {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsComponent SsComponent}
079 * values before editing.
080 * <li> it has implementations of
081 * {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.products.DbOpsBase#performPostInsertOps(dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsModel) performPostInsertOps(rowsModel)}
082 * and other {@code performPost*Ops} that use metadata to decide if
083 * the RowSet command needs to be re-executed.
084 * <li> it handles state info for
085 * allow update/insert/delete.
086 * </ul>
087 */
088// TODO: rename SsDbCustomOps
089public interface DbOps {
090  /** For an event, to specify which field changed. */
091  /** The allow Fields. Used in event notification, see {@link DbOpsChangeEvent} */
092  public enum Allow {
093    /** update */ UPDATE,
094    /** insert */ INSERT,
095    /** delete */ DELETE,
096  }
097
098  /**
099   * This function is called as the first step, before inserting the row into
100   * the database, of {@link RowsAction#ACT_COMMIT}.
101   *
102   * @return true if row can be inserted, false aborts the operation
103   */
104  default boolean allowInsert() {
105    return true;
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * This function is called as the first step, before performPreDeletionOps
110   * is called, of {@link RowsAction#ACT_DELETE}.
111   *
112   * @return true if the row can be deleted else false and the action is aborted
113   */
114  default boolean allowDelete() {
115    return true;
116  }
117
118  /**
119   * This functions is called just before doing something that is sensitive
120   * to a row being dirty. When it returns true, it is followed by
121   * rowSet.updateRow(). Note that the default for {@code AutoCommit} is false.
122   * So the behavior of {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsDataNavigator} in conjunction with
123   * {@link RowsAction} is that when the current row is dirty only
124   * commit and undo are enabled.
125   *
126   * @return true is the row can be updated else false.
127   */
128  default boolean allowUpdate() {
129    return true;
130  }
131
132  /**
133   * This method is invoked by {@link RowsAction#ACT_REVERT}, the undo
134   * button, to perform operations after
135   * either rowSet.cancelRowUpdates or rowSet.moveToCurrentRow.
136   * Only meaningful if either the current row
137   * is modified, or a row is being inserted.
138   */
139  default void performCancelOps() {}
140
141  /**
142   * Method to perform operations when the user hits the refresh button.
143   * This method is invoked at the end of {@link RowsAction#ACT_REFRESH};
144   * note the rowSet's query is re-executed and the cursor is positioned
145   * at the first row.
146   */
147  default void performRefreshOps() {}
148
149  /**
150   * Method to perform navigation-related operations, in particular at the
151   * end of
152   * {@link RowsAction#ACT_FIRST}, {@link RowsAction#ACT_LAST},
153   * {@link RowsAction#ACT_NEXT}, and {@link RowsAction#ACT_PREVIOUS}.
154   *
155   * @param navigationType type of navigation that was done
156   */
157  default void performNavigationOps(Navigation navigationType) {}
158
159  /**
160   * Method to perform pre-insertion operations by {@link RowsAction#ACT_ADD}
161   * after rowSet.moveToInsertRow. Typically initializes all the columns'
162   * {@code SsComponent}s. See
163   * {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.products.DbOpsBase#performPreInsertOps()}.
164   */
165  default void performPreInsertOps() {}
166
167  /**
168   * Method to perform post-insertion operations during
169   * {@link RowsAction#ACT_COMMIT} after rowSet.insertRow.
170   * If the insert is aborted, {@link RowsAction#ACT_REVERT} cancelling
171   * a pending insert, this is not called.
172   * <p>
173   * In addition to this, a listener on the RowSet is
174   * notified after the RowSet is modified.
175   * @param rm
176   * @throws java.sql.SQLException
177   */
178  default void performPostInsertOps(RowsModel rm) throws SQLException {}
179
180  /**
181   * Method to perform pre-deletion operations; it is used for
182   * {@link RowsAction#ACT_DELETE}, invoked just before rowSet.deleteRow().
183   */
184  default void performPreDeletionOps() {}
185
186  /**
187   * Method to perform post-deletion operations; it is used for
188   * {@link RowsAction#ACT_DELETE}, invoked just after rowSet.deleteRow().
189   * <p>
190   * In addition to this, a listener on the RowSet is
191   * notified after the RowSet is modified.
192   * @param rm
193   * @throws java.sql.SQLException
194   */
195  default void performPostDeletionOps(RowsModel rm) throws SQLException {}
196
197  /**
198   * Method to perform operations at the end of {@link RowsAction#ACT_COMMIT}
199   * when the current row is modified, i.e. not on the insert row.
200   * It is invoked after rowSet.updateRow().
201   * @param rm
202   * @throws java.sql.SQLException
203   */
204  default void performPostUpdateOps(RowsModel rm) throws SQLException {}
205}
